notes: This minor release adds policies. It requires Bifrost 0.15.2 or later, as rules 0.14.0 did, and depends exactly on bifrost.public.packs 0.14.0. Every locked policy identity verifies on the released Bifrost 0.15.2. New policies in bifrost.rust-codeql-quality 0.3.0, each aligned with a CodeQL Rust query at github/codeql ae741615f3e178ce61289a651790dc67fcc18e19 (#400): access-after-lifetime-ended and access-invalid-pointer report pointer accesses after the pointee's lifetime ended or through an invalid pointer; unused-variable reports a local that is never read; unused-value reports a dead write. Known deviation: unused-value also reports _-prefixed locals that CodeQL excludes, because assignment relations carry no binding name (bifrost-dev#13914). access-after-lifetime-ended can report one access once per origin (bifrost-dev#13025). New opt-in policies in bifrost.security 3.1.0 (#392): bifrost.security.ruby.network-xml-to-rexml-attribute-value-dos (CVE-2024-35176), bifrost.security.ruby.network-xml-to-rexml-repeated-declaration-dos (CVE-2025-58767), bifrost.security.ruby.network-input-to-net-imap-raw-arguments (CVE-2026-47240, CVE-2026-47241), bifrost.security.ruby.network-input-to-gem-installer (CVE-2017-0903, install part only) and bifrost.security.csharp.webassembly-debugging-affected-version (CVE-2026-96230, affected-version part). Limitation: these five policies need the Ruby rexml, net-imap and rubygems-installer models and the C# ASP.NET Core WebAssembly server and hosting models, which are source-only in this repository and are not in bifrost.public.packs 0.14.0. With only the released packs, Bifrost 0.15.2 cannot bind their sinks and reports each run as inconclusive (partial_discovery) with no findings, never clean; checked for the CVE-2024-35176 rule on its rexml 3.2.6 fixture. A project can supply the models itself under .bifrost/semantic-models, as the fixtures do. A later packs release will add them. All other policies, IDs and required capabilities are unchanged from rules 0.14.0. This release does not qualify the full policy set or imply complete analysis.
